purpose: establish deterministic partial geometries for intrinsic market-process objects without selecting one universal representation

authority.gate15_use: retrospective diagnostic reference only after representation and distance parameters are frozen
authority.gate15_5_use: retrospective structural diagnostic only; Master state is excluded from intrinsic representations

public_comparison.distance_domain: explicit subset of represented object pairs

direction_maps.raw: preserve prices and event directions as observed
direction_maps.reflection: explicit directional reflection M with M(M(x))=x
direction_maps.canonicalization: conditional origin-direction map C with C(C(x))=C(x)
direction_maps.law: reflection and canonicalization are distinct operations

summary.scaling: exploratory-corpus median and IQR fitted separately by object kind

trajectory.grid: 21 points over the common admitted interval
trajectory.complete_mode: full observed life only for completed objects
trajectory.shared_prefix_mode: compare both objects on [0,min(observed_age_left,observed_age_right)] before common rescaling

event_sequence.timing: bars and seconds since prior event
event_sequence.terminal_policy: completed mode and observed-prefix mode remain distinct

graph.admission_law: graph must report whether it adds local geometry beyond its event-sequence source

collision_epsilon.basis: f32 derived-artifact precision; not a market-probability threshold

invariants: Gate 15 and Gate 15.5 artifacts remain byte-identical
representation parameters freeze before retrospective family diagnostics
no universal winner, clustering, new family, prediction, strategy, or economic interpretation
